game.name: DigiScreen
game.desc: See your Elektron instrument's screen on the handheld, over MIDI, using the instrument's own screenshot command. Nothing on the machine is modified. A PortMaster port of the screendump tool (Jakob Bak, MIT). Pairing loop cycles Digitone / Digitakt / Syntakt and streams the first machine that answers, at the instrument's own refresh rate.\n\nRuns inside the vaixterm terminal emulator with a full gptokeyb gamepad control layer: A=save frame, B=quit stream back to pairing, X=render mode (braille/blocks/ascii), Y=invert, L1=help, R1=flip, L2/R2=pause. Requires an Elektron Digitone / Digitakt / Syntakt connected by USB-MIDI. Fully exit with the EmulationStation hotkey.
